I’m Dalton, a molecular biology student at Brigham Young University
working at the intersection of bacteriophage genomics, bioinformatics,
and scientific software.

I welcome conversations about research, open-source tools, and
projects that bring biology and computation together.

## Get in touch

Email is the best place to start for research questions,
collaboration ideas, or a general introduction.

If you’re reaching out about a project, a little context helps:
what you’re working on, what caught your interest, and what you’d
like to explore together.

## Questions about my software?

For bugs, feature requests, or reproducible problems, please use
the relevant project’s GitHub issue tracker when one is available.
That keeps the discussion connected to the code and useful to
other people working through the same issue.

For anything private, use email instead.

## Website feedback

If you find a broken link, an error, or something that makes this
site difficult to use, I’d appreciate hearing about it. Please include
the page address and a brief description of the problem. You can open an issue [here](https://github.com/dkutzen22/kutzen.org/issues/new)
